title: A gallon of regular in Austin
subtitle: AAA average for the Austin-San Marcos metro, read Sept. 20
alt: Bar chart of the average price of a gallon of regular unleaded gasoline in the Austin-San Marcos metropolitan area, as published by the American Automobile Association (AAA) on September 20, 2026. A year ago the average was 2 dollars and 74 cents. A month ago it was 3 dollars and 57 cents. A week ago it was 3 dollars and 89 cents. On September 20, 2026 it was 3 dollars and 94 cents.
